key_safety.text: The most frequent adverse drug reactions were headache, fatigue, and nausea. In ASTRAL-1 (SOF/VEL 12 weeks) adverse reactions >=5% included headache (22%), fatigue (15%), nausea (9%), asthenia (5%), and insomnia (5%). In ASTRAL-4 (decompensated cirrhosis, SOF/VEL + RBV 12 weeks) the most common (>=10%) were fatigue (32%), anemia (26%), nausea (15%), headache (11%), insomnia (11%), and diarrhea (10%).

citations.quote: The most frequent adverse drug reactions were headache, fatigue, and nausea.

Adverse reactions of all grades, observed in greater than or equal to 5% of patients receiving 12 weeks of treatment with SOF/VEL in ASTRAL 1 include headache (22%), fatigue (15%), nausea (9%), asthenia (5%), and insomnia (5%); most had an adverse reaction of mild severity (Grade 1).

In ASTRAL 4, the most common adverse reactions, all grades with frequency of 10% or greater in patients who received SOF/VEL with RBV for 12 weeks were fatigue (32%), anemia (26%), nausea (15%), headache (11%), insomnia (11%), and diarrhea (10%); most of these adverse reactions were mild to moderate in severity.
